name: USCensus_get_population
description: Get population and demographic data from the US Census Bureau API. Access decennial census and American Community Survey (ACS) data at national, state, county, and city levels. A free CENSUS_API_KEY is required. Variables include total population, housing units, age groups, and race/ethnicity breakdowns. Useful for demographic research, urban planning, and social science analysis. Register at https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html.

get.description: Comma-separated variable codes to retrieve plus NAME. For 2020 decennial: 'P1_001N,NAME' (total pop). For ACS 5-year (B01003_001E=total pop, B19013_001E=median income, B01002_001E=median age). Example: 'NAME,B01003_001E,B19013_001E'

for.description: Geographic unit. Examples: 'state:*' (all states), 'county:*' (all counties), 'state:06' (California), or 'county:001' together with in='state:06' (Alameda County CA)

dataset.description: Dataset to query. Values: '2020/dec/pl' (2020 decennial), '2022/acs/acs5' (ACS 5-year 2022), '2021/acs/acs1' (ACS 1-year 2021). Default: 2022/acs/acs5

in.description: Geographic filter for sub-national queries. Examples: 'state:06' (within California)

limit.description: Maximum number of data rows to return (the header row is preserved and is not counted)

data.description: Census data as a 2D array. First row is the header; subsequent rows are data.

CENSUS_API_KEY.purpose: Pull population, demographic, and economic data from the US Census Bureau (decennial + ACS).
CENSUS_API_KEY.without: Census endpoints return an HTML rate-limit page that breaks the tool's JSON parser. Free to register.
